title: Second derivations in prime rings
ref: Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. 63 (1957), 143-146; Posner's second theorem. Probes through 2026-11-07: no Crossref or OpenAlex record for this Bulletin announcement; the AMS site answers every request with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403, "Verifying your connection"); archive.org holds only the volume 63 index for 1957, not the body pages; LibGen returns a different work for the title. The statement is carried by the 2021 Prajapati recall (Ann. Univ. Ferrara 67, p. 4)

title: On generalized biderivations and related maps
ref: J. Algebra 172(3) (1995), 764-786, doi 10.1006/jabr.1995.1069; Bresar's generalized biderivation. The library copy was an image-only scan; it was OCR'd on 2026-11-07 (ocrmypdf, 300 dpi CCITT source) and saved beside the original as "On Generalized Biderivations and Related Maps (1995)-ocr.pdf". The text layer reads the title page and the introduction, so the definition can be read first-hand

title: Local derivations and local automorphisms of B(X)
ref: Proc. Sympos. Pure Math. 51 (1990), 187-194; Larson and Sourour; every local derivation of B(X) is a derivation, and surjective local automorphisms of B(X) are automorphisms. Re-probed 2026-11-07: papergraph resolves no open-access URL, with and without --refresh; LibGen and Sci-Hub return nothing; the AMS proceedings volume is not in archive.org. Recalled in the handbook through Kadison 1990 (J. Algebra 130, p. 494) and Crist 1996 (J. Funct. Anal. 135, p. 76)
